scope: One qualified BASE scene, six fresh fixed consumers, text-only common task.
complete_correct: The final answer, including any clearly incorporated complete visible business list, establishes exactly all true triangle-surface distance matches at the exact binary64 0.002 metre threshold, accurate distances, uniquely resolvable labels and an explicit completeness statement. No weighted compensation applies.

status_categories.incorrect: A definite wrong pair, distance, duplicate, wrong completeness claim, or unsupported additional deterministic claim is present. Definite error takes priority over incompleteness.
status_categories.incomplete: Missing or uncertain task facts, including honestly admitted unresolved coverage or absent completeness statement, without a definite error.
status_categories.execution_failure: A started execution fails or does not provide a confirmed usable final answer. Preserve partial text and all attempts.
status_categories.not_run: A planned slot did not start. Preserve its place in the six-slot denominator.

distance_policy.classification: Compare exact squared rational distance to the square of Fraction(binary64(0.002)). Display rounding does not change membership.
distance_policy.display: Accept at least three decimal places, exact zero written as 0, and equivalent scientific notation. Independently resolve unambiguous explicitly stated equivalent units; record presentation deviations separately.
distance_policy.numeric_reference: pairs[].exact_squared_distance_m2 contains exact numerator and denominator integer strings. Test the squared stated-distance tolerance interval against this exact value, avoiding a rounded oracle sqrt.

evidence_policy.common_standard: Apply the same fact and source rules to every anonymous answer.
evidence_policy.native_tools: Batch reads, Blender APIs, NumPy/BVH and per-cell scripts/caches are eligible. No forced tool, proof algorithm or path is required.
evidence_policy.source_binding: Recorded business evidence and initial/final captures must concern the frozen current scene. The final answer need not repeat administrative hashes or IDs.
evidence_policy.extra_facts: No world witnesses, negative-pair list, solid classification or manually reproduced proof is required. Extra deterministic errors are recorded.
evidence_policy.solid_scope: Surface distance alone does not establish collision freedom, penetration depth or containment. A surface nonmatch is not a certificate of no solid collision.
evidence_policy.mechanism: Tool adoption, fallback and repeated computation are assessed after anonymous quality is frozen.

fixed_sample_policy: Exactly N1/P1, P2/N2, N3/P3. All failures, unknowns and not-run slots remain; no replacement or selective pooling.
anonymization_policy: First share only the public package. Mask group labels, administrative timings and usage envelopes; preserve final bytes, native stdout, query/code, all business facts, errors, unknowns and duplicate attempts. Tool content can reveal route, so blindness is imperfect.

independent_truth_layout.pairs: All 276 unordered object pairs with exact squared distances and threshold membership.
